text:
Maria - eng-sre: Heads up — apiserver 5xx spike in us-west-2 started ~11:42 UTC. customer-facing pools reporting failed pod creates. :rotating_light:
Liam - infra-oncall: I see controller-manager leader transitions on two control-plane nodes, repeated every ~30s. kube-controller-manager logs show `watch cache re-list` timeouts.
Jon - eng-platform: Prometheus alert fired: `APIServerHigh5xxRate` and `ControllerManagerLeaderFlapping`. grabbing logs now.
Maria - eng-sre: Suspect etcd pressure — I can see a bunch of compaction/snapshot activity in etcd metrics around the same time: etcd_disk_backend_commit_duration_seconds spikes.
Liam - infra-oncall: Running `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` — apiserver on cp-1 and cp-3 restart count increased, etcd-2 shows higher disk IO in node metrics.
Sophia - eng-runtime: We also got a support ticket: GPU pod creations time out while the apiserver is degrading. Dedicated GPU pools failing to provision because the cluster-autoscaler hits API timeout.
Jon - eng-platform: Note: cloud provider rate limit warnings in the autoscaler logs: `quota exceeded` and `429`. Autoscaler retries are backing up requests to apiserver.
Maria - eng-sre: Infra-bot snapshot: 
```
infra-bot: [11:44:12 UTC] ALERT: etcd_compaction_duration_seconds exceeded threshold on us-west-2-cluster
k8s-deploy-bot: [11:45:05 UTC] Event: apiserver crashloop detected on cp-3
```
Liam - infra-oncall: Quick mitigation attempt: scaling down non-critical control-plane addons to reduce etcd load (metrics, dashboard). Patching `--etcd-quota-backend-bytes` temporarily is risky in-prod.
Jon - eng-platform: Can we throttle autoscaler or add backoff so it doesn't hammer apiserver while etcd busy? We can set `--scale-down-unneeded-time` higher and reduce concurrent node creation.
Sophia - eng-runtime: Also seeing pod admission webhooks (image-policy) timeouts — they amplify latency. Suggest toggling webhook to `fail-open` temporarily.
Maria - eng-sre: Action list: 1) Liam to put autoscaler into maintenance mode (reduce concurrency) 2) Jon to add temporary webhook fail-open 3) Sophia to pause GPU provisioning queues 4) Maria to monitor etcd compaction progress and disk IO.
Liam - infra-oncall: On it. Setting autoscaler to low-concurrency mode and adding 60s backoff.
Jon - eng-platform: Webhook set to fail-open. Notifying downstream teams.
Sophia - eng-runtime: Paused GPU job queueing in dispatch service, sent banner to support.
Maria - eng-sre: Disk IO on etcd-2 is slowly returning to baseline, apiserver 5xx rate dropping. Controller-manager leader stable for last 2 min.
infra-bot: [11:57:00 UTC] RESOLVED: APIServerHigh5xxRate — monitoring for 15m.
Maria - eng-sre: Postmortem notes to collect: etcd compaction schedule vs snapshot timeline, autoscaler behavior under API saturation, webhook timeouts causing cascading failures, and GPU provisioning retry/backoff defaults. Also check whether compaction was triggered by backup job that ran at 11:40.
Liam - infra-oncall: I'll capture etcd defrag/compaction logs and disk metrics.
Jon - eng-platform: I'll open a ticket to add autoscaler circuit-breaker tied to apiserver error rates and a cloud quota check before requesting GPUs.
Sophia - eng-runtime: We should add a canary for admission webhook latency and make GPU provisioning queue resilient to API transient errors.
Maria - eng-sre: Thanks team. If anything else flares up, ping here. :thumbsup:
